disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了插件全部代码与配置，未发现任何读取本机敏感凭据文件（如凭据配置、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据）的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Scanned all plugin code and configuration; no code path reading local sensitive credential files (such as credential config, SSH private keys, or cloud provider credentials) was detected.

checked_items.zh: 附带脚本中出现的 token 仅用于连接用户自设的本机机器人接口（默认 127.0.0.1），属于开发者工具，非运行时行为，且不构成凭据外泄。
checked_items.en: The token in the bundled script is only used to connect to a user-configured local bot interface (default 127.0.0.1); it is a developer tool, not runtime behavior, and does not constitute credential exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 客户端代码未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用宿主凭据接口的行为。
checked_items.en: No keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or calls to host credential interfaces were found in the client code.

evidence.zh: 未命中凭据读取面：主程序与浏览器端均未访问凭据文件或凭据接口，只有开发者脚本可携带用户自设的机器人 token 访问本机接口，运行时无任何凭据接触。
evidence.en: No credential reading surface hit: neither the main program nor the browser side accesses credential files or credential interfaces; only a developer script can carry a user-configured bot token to access the local interface, and there is no credential contact at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本的调用，工具描述投毒与系统提示注入面不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools and makes no calls that inject text into system prompts; the tool description poisoning and system prompt injection surfaces are not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 仓库内未发现代理指令类文件（如 AGENTS/SKILL/CLAUDE 等），README 与文档中没有指令覆写、系统消息伪装或诱导安装类措辞。
checked_items.en: No agent instruction files (such as AGENTS/SKILL/CLAUDE) were found in the repository; the README and documentation contain no wording that overrides instructions, disguises system messages, or induces installation.

checked_items.zh: 示例词库里的搞笑文案是纯展示文本，仅显示在界面状态标签上，不会进入模型上下文，也不会被当作指令执行。
checked_items.en: The humorous copy in the sample lexicon is purely display text, shown only on UI status labels; it does not enter the model context and is not executed as instructions.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件未注册任何工具描述，也没有注册系统提示片段，模型请求面无该插件注入的文本。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin registers no tool descriptions and no system prompt snippets, so there is no plugin-injected text on the model request surface.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件没有任何工具描述可诱导安装或改写配置；安装方式由宿主命令行管理，插件本身不包含诱导安装措辞。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin has no tool descriptions that could induce installation or rewrite configuration; installation is managed by the host command line, and the plugin itself contains no wording that induces installation.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只包含一行插件插入声明，没有可执行脚本标签，不存在配置即执行风险。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration contains only a one-line plugin insertion declaration, with no executable script tags, so there is no configuration-as-code execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 主程序未发现 eval、动态函数、子进程执行等危险调用；测试脚本使用沙箱执行仅用于开发期自测，不随插件运行。
checked_items.en: No dangerous calls such as eval, dynamic functions, or subprocess execution were found in the main program; the test script uses sandbox execution only for development-time self-testing and does not run with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 安装清单中没有任何安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），也没有 git 依赖或可变版本引用。
checked_items.en: The install manifest contains no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare), and no git dependencies or mutable version references.

checked_items.zh: 两条 CI 工作流（发布流水线与测试流水线）经内容核查为常规工程实践：发布流程打包并上传 GitHub Release，测试流程跑冒烟测试；均无远程下载执行、无凭据读取，命中规则 DSH-X07（对应 DG-R3-59）判定为良性，排除。
checked_items.en: The two CI workflows (release pipeline and test pipeline) were content-audited as standard engineering practice: the release pipeline packages and uploads GitHub Releases, and the test pipeline runs smoke tests; neither involves remote download-and-execute or credential reading. This hits rule DSH-X07 (corresponding to DG-R3-59) and is adjudged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端加载，客户端代码已专项核查：无键盘监听、无剪贴板访问、无调用宿主凭据接口，仅替换界面状态文案并读取会话展示信息。
checked_items.en: The plugin declares browser-side loading; the client code was specifically audited: no keyboard listening, no clipboard access, no calls to host credential interfaces, only UI status text replacement and reading session display information.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 只含插入条目，未发现可执行脚本标量，无配置即执行风险。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml contains only insertion entries; no executable script scalars were found, so there is no configuration-as-code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件未引用宿主提供的动态代码执行工具，没有让模型在宿主内运行代码的调用面。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin does not reference dynamic code execution tools provided by the host and has no call surface that lets the model run code inside the host.

evidence.zh: 安装清单无安装钩子；两条 CI 工作流（DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59）为常规发布与测试流水线，排除。
evidence.en: The install manifest has no install hooks; the two CI workflows (DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59) are standard release and test pipelines and are excluded.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端自动加载，但客户端代码经扫描无键盘、剪贴板或凭据接口调用，仅做界面文案替换与会话展示信息读取。
evidence.en: The plugin declares automatic browser-side loading, but the client code was scanned with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential interface calls; it only does UI text replacement and session display information reading.

checked_items.zh: 运行时无出站外联：主程序不发起任何网络请求；浏览器端默认只读取本机插件配置路由，发送保存请求也仅到本机路由。
checked_items.en: No outbound connections at runtime: the main program makes no network requests; the browser side by default only reads the local plugin configuration route, and save requests go only to the local route.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端存在外部 JSON 地址选项，但默认关闭且需用户在本机浏览器存储中显式设置，配置内容只用于展示文案，不构成外泄通道。
checked_items.en: The browser side has an optional external JSON address, but it is disabled by default and requires the user to explicitly set it in the local browser storage; the configuration content is used only for display text and does not constitute an exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 开发者脚本按用户指定地址（默认本机）拉取群成员名单生成文案，属开发工具，不随插件运行，无外泄行为。
checked_items.en: The developer script pulls a member list from a user-specified address (default local) to generate copy; it is a development tool, does not run with the plugin, and has no exfiltration behavior.

evidence.zh: 未命中外联通道：运行时无凭据读取与网络外发的组合，浏览器端仅访问本机配置路由，外部地址需用户显式开启且只接收展示文案。
evidence.en: No outbound channel hit: at runtime there is no combination of credential reading and network exfiltration; the browser side only accesses the local configuration route, and the external address requires explicit user opt-in and only receives display text.

checked_items.zh: 依赖面极小：安装清单没有任何第三方依赖声明，也没有安装钩子或 git 可变引用，供应链攻击面近乎为零。
checked_items.en: The dependency surface is minimal: the install manifest declares no third-party dependencies, and has no install hooks or git mutable references, so the supply chain attack surface is nearly zero.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置不触碰任何安全行（沙箱、审批、权限、加载器），没有禁用配置或环境变量降权写法，也没有改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration does not touch any security lines (sandbox, approval, permissions, loader), has no disabled config or environment variable downgrade patterns, and does not rewrite injection/interception settings.

checked_items.zh: 插件未监听安全事件，不存在截断审批链的监听器；首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活场景不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not listen to security events, so there is no listener that could truncate the approval chain; first audit has no version baseline, so the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 作者与仓库同名（01virex），无仿冒官方插件名称的迹象；动态引入的宿主 SDK 模块按宿主提供处理，未独立核验。
checked_items.en: The author and repository share the same name (01virex), with no signs of impersonating official plugin names; the dynamically imported host SDK modules are treated as host-provided and were not independently verified.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件声明，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，也没有禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration only inserts a plugin declaration and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, nor does it contain disabled or downgraded patterns.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件未注册任何安全事件监听器，不存在截断审批链的监听面。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin registers no security event listeners, so there is no listening surface that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 不适用：首次审计无版本基线可比较，无法评估升级后自动激活的能力突变。
evidence.en: Not applicable: first audit has no version baseline for comparison, so it is impossible to evaluate capability mutation after upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务造成持续等待。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite injection or interception settings, so it will not cause persistent waiting by appending required services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件未启动独立监听服务，只在宿主网页服务器上注册一条本插件配置读取/保存路由，属宿主无认证接口的固有生态风险，非本插件新增服务面。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own listening service; it only registers a plugin configuration read/save route on the host web server, which is an inherent ecosystem risk of the host's unauthenticated interface, not a new service surface introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 配置保存接口有请求体上限与结构校验，保存内容仅影响本插件展示文案，不触及代码执行；宿主本机接口无认证属生态固有风险，已在范围说明中标注。
checked_items.en: The config save endpoint has a request body size limit and structural validation; the saved content affects only the plugin's display text and does not touch code execution; the host's local unauthenticated interface is an inherent ecosystem risk and is noted in the scope description.

evidence.zh: 不适用：插件没有自行启动网页服务或监听端口，仅在宿主网页服务器上注册配置路由；宿主无认证接口属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; it only registers a configuration route on the host web server; the host's unauthenticated interface is an inherent ecosystem risk, not an issue of this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件声明完整，作者与仓库一致，无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: plugin declaration is complete, author matches repository, and there are no name impersonation signs.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：预扫命中的两条 CI 工作流经内容核查为常规工程流水线，排除；未发现可执行配置、危险调用或安装钩子。
summary.en: Static scan passed: the two CI workflows hit in the pre-scan were content-audited as standard engineering pipelines and excluded; no executable configuration, dangerous calls, or install hooks were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reading, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：无工具描述、无系统提示注入、无诱导安装措辞，示例文案为纯展示文本。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tool descriptions, no system prompt injection, no install-inducing wording; sample copy is pure display text.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境未提供动态验证产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts were available in this environment).

target.en: dsh-status-rotator@0.6.6#c67fe4c2 (repository root, full audit, first release)

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用）。插件未声明宿主版本（安装清单无 engines 段），兼容性按未测试处理。插件动态引入宿主 SDK 模块（@deepseek-ai/schemastery、@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings），不在自身依赖清单中，按宿主提供处理、未独立核验。浏览器端外部 JSON 地址需用户在本机浏览器存储中显式设置，未计入默认外联面。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (L4 not enabled). The plugin does not declare a host version (the install manifest has no engines section), so compatibility is treated as untested. The plugin dynamically imports host SDK modules (@deepseek-ai/schemastery, @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings), which are not in its own dependency list and are treated as host-provided without independent verification. The browser-side external JSON address requires explicit user setting in local browser storage and is not counted in the default outbound surface.
